title: Association between Player Perception and AI Disclosure on Steam: An Exploratory Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.30178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of generative AI in game development is growing rapidly and is the subject of intense debate in which player reactions play a central role. This paper contributes to this discussion by analyzing Steam reviews to examine whether games with AI disclosure are associated with different review patterns. Using a dataset across multiple disclosure groups, we apply linguistic analysis including keyword-based, word frequency, and characteristic word analysis to investigate the AI-related discussion on Steam. Our results show that AI-disclosed games are associated with higher levels of AI-related criticism in negative reviews. Our findings provide a first exploratory step towards understanding how players perceive AI disclosure.

translated_title: Steam平台上玩家认知与AI披露之间的关联：一项探索性研究
translated_abstract: 生成式AI在游戏开发中的应用正迅速增长，并成为激烈辩论的焦点，其中玩家的反应扮演着核心角色。本文通过分析Steam评论，探讨披露使用AI的游戏是否与不同的评论模式相关联，从而为这一讨论做出贡献。我们使用跨越多个披露组别的数据集，应用包括关键词分析、词频分析和特征词分析在内的语言分析方法，来研究Steam上与AI相关的讨论。结果表明，披露使用AI的游戏在负面评论中与更高程度的AI相关批评相关联。我们的发现为理解玩家如何感知AI披露迈出了首个探索性步伐。
tldr: 该研究通过分析Steam评论发现，披露使用生成式AI的游戏在负面评论中会引来更多AI相关的批评，为理解玩家对AI披露的感知提供了首个探索性证据。
en_tdlr: This study finds through Steam review analysis that games disclosing generative AI use attract higher levels of AI-related criticism in negative reviews, offering a first exploratory step toward understanding player perception of AI disclosure.
